ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white/light-grey pixels dominate approximately 80% of the ventral surface area, contrasted against low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels localized at the perimeter and in focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity central region bounded by a low-intensity dark perimeter. Five primary high-contrast dark circular blobs are mapped: one on the distal left lobe, one on the proximal left lobe, and three clustered in the mid-to-distal right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression at the axis of symmetry with an approximate pixel-calculated interior angle of 40-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks) visible across the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased amplitude and irregularity towards the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex sweep towards the lateral fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of at least six dark circular pixel clusters (5-15 pixels in diameter) distributed non-uniformly across the light ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct thin, curved low-intensity linear disruptions visible on the medial-to-lateral region of the right fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple circular dark spots across the ventral surface indicative of healed attachment sites; irregular jagged texture on distal tips.
